title: Hex and Tractian crash the Sprint pack
lede: Two $100M+ rounds and a few hiring pushes reshuffled the top 100. Four companies entered, six slipped out, and most of the drops below are just new entries pushing everyone down.

items.name: Hex
items.why: A fresh $100M round in October gives Hex full funding credit, on top of 39 open roles. That lifts it two zones.

items.name: Thatch
items.why: Open roles grew from 28 to 31, enough to earn a bigger hiring score and a long jump inside Sprint.

items.name: Dust
items.why: Hiring jumped from 24 to 32 open roles, crossing the 30-role mark.

items.name: Tessera Labs
items.why: Open roles went from 26 to 30, which tips it into Sprint.

items.name: Simile
items.why: A small hiring gain (9 to 10 open roles) crossed a scoring bucket and moved it into Sprint.

items.name: Tractian
items.why: A $130M round in October plus strong traction put it straight into the top 25.

items.name: Upwind
items.why: A $400M round in October. Biggest cheque of the week.

items.name: Quartermaster
items.why: A real drop: open roles fell from 11 to 8, costing hiring points.

items.name: Scribe
items.why: A real drop: open roles slid from 31 to 28, below the 30-role mark.

items.name: Suno
items.why: Score unchanged. Four new entries above it pushed it out of the 100.

items.name: Slash
items.why: Unchanged, pushed out by new entries.

items.name: Column
items.why: Unchanged, pushed out by new entries.

items.name: Abridge
items.why: Unchanged, pushed out by new entries.

items.name: Corgi
items.why: Unchanged, pushed out by new entries.
